inputs.d0: results/phase6i_urgency_highlevel_pilot labels for scenarios 322000-322003 at t=0,15,30

candidate_scope: 128 sampled candidates per state, not the full 13327 pool

formulas.dominates: payload and urgent are no worse than the other, and at least one is better by more than 1 bit
formulas.lambda_cross: (payload_i - payload_j) / (urgent_j - urgent_i) in the shared normalized units
formulas.material_payload_regret_bits: 0 when the absolute payload gap is at most 1 bit, otherwise payload - best_payload

rules.payload_first: maximum payload, urgent service breaks ties within 1 bit
rules.payload_constrained_urgency: maximize urgent service subject to a payload-loss budget; the budget is not chosen
rules.weighted_sum: critical intervals of nonnegative lambda_H from the convex sampled front; no single weight is selected
